name: Poundcrown
description: Strike down with the head and bring the pommel round at once, so two blows follow one swing.

name: Warding Ribhead
description: Hold the haft crossed before the chest so head and pommel guard either side together.

name: Ethereal Studhead
description: Step in twos, one for the head and one for the pommel, keeping both ends of the haft ready.

name: Quenched Bellhead
description: Rap the opponent's guard in a measured series, alternating head and pommel, until the guard wavers.

name: Deluge Flangerib
description: Parry high with the head, let the pommel swing back to turn a second blow low.

name: Millstone Dent
description: Hook head and pommel behind two points of a limb and draw them together.

name: Quenched Pearhead
description: Land head and pommel in turn on one plate so the second blow drives the first one deeper.

name: Gloomsmash
description: Press head and pommel down on a guard together until the arm behind it gives way.

name: Thunderclap Crush
description: Cast both ends of the mace down in one fall so the guard and the armor behind it break together.

name: Tenetmace
description: The school's cycle of paired strokes, each blow answering the last, ending in a final crushing stroke that the opponent cannot answer.

name: Vigor Smash
description: Strike from the high perch with the head dropping straight onto the opponent's shoulder.

name: Consecrated Ironknob
description: Settle into a low basin guard with the head near the shin and the pommel at the chest.

name: Gliding Haftring
description: Land from the stoop onto a firm front step, the head already rising for the second blow.

name: Unbending Maceball
description: Rise to the perch as if for a stoop, then strike low at the exposed knee.

name: Peal Wristloop
description: Turn an incoming blow round the rim of the basin guard and return it down the haft.

name: Masterful Pulp
description: Hook the flange at the river's edge of the opponent's guard and draw the arm out along it.

name: Batterverdict
description: Stoop from the perch with the head's full weight onto a raised guard, forcing it down.

name: Quenched Pound
description: Drive a crushing stroke into the centre of the opponent's basin guard so the whole defence folds in.

name: Vacuumdent
description: Cast a crushing stroke from the perch and settle into the basin guard in the same breath.

name: Season Dent
description: The school's answer, a stoop from the perch followed by a settling basin guard that no counterblow passes.

name: Triumphant Thunderclap Maceneck
description: The school's closing stroke, a stoop timed to land just as the opponent's counter fails.

name: Steel Haftring
description: Strike with the paired heads at once so their blows fall a hand's width apart.

name: Deluge Ribhead
description: Turn a blade along the haft and out through the second head as water runs off a bank.

name: Windborne Maceball
description: Slide forward along a straight line with both heads low, keeping the haft level.

name: Vigordent
description: Rake both heads along an opponent's guard in a single sweeping drag.

name: Thrallrib
description: Let a thin current run between the heads and use it to hold the opponent's weapon between them.

name: Maceneck Seal
description: Strike both rims of a guard at once so the opponent's defence is knocked off the line.

name: Prism Studhead
description: Feed qi from one head into the other so the second blow lands with the first one's force added.

name: Statute Wristloop
description: Let the weight of both heads run down a guard and press the opponent back a pace.

name: Steelpear
description: Cast both heads down on a river of qi that breaks the target and spreads the shock to those near.

name: Resonant Tenet Crush
description: The school's run of strokes in which qi passes from head to head, each blow heavier than the one before.

name: Haemal Batter
description: Swing the heavy head overhead and let the weight carry it down the line of attack.

name: Bedrock Pearhead
description: Set the haft against a heavy blow and let qi run through it to the planted feet.

name: Fleet Bellhead
description: Stride forward along a basin's gentle curve so each pace brings the head nearer its mark.

name: Denttriumph
description: Strike a guard's rim again and again so the pounding spreads through the arm behind it.

name: Ironknob Seal
description: Run a current of qi down the haft to turn a heavy blow aside without losing the stance.

name: Sigilpear
description: Hook the flange over a limb and pull with both hands while qi runs through the arms.

name: Splendid Flangerib
description: Send qi through full meridians into the head so a heavy blow lands on the guard.

name: Vacuum Smash
description: Let the weight flow down into a limb so the blow crushes through the guard and breaks the bone behind.

name: Bedrock Pulp
description: Press the guard and let the opponent's own weight run off the haft, leaving them off balance.

name: Solarpulp
description: Bring the weight round in a wide sweep that strikes several close opponents in one stroke.

name: Macebanner
description: Cast the whole river of qi through the haft into the head, crushing plate and the body beneath.

name: Unrivaled Thunderclap Ribhead
description: The school's heaviest stroke, a downward blow that breaks the guard and drives the opponent to the ground.

name: Inferno Wristloop
description: Strike with the field wrapped around both heads so the blow lands before the weapon arrives.

name: Prismrib
description: Spread the field between the heads and take a blow into it without moving the haft.

name: Vigormace
description: Shift the stance in a stepwise descent, matching each step to a fall of the heads.

name: Eclipse Pearhead
description: Spread the field out to the basin's rim to feel where an opponent's guard thins.

name: Despotic Pound
description: Hook the flange with a field of qi and draw the opponent's arm into the paired heads.

name: Thunderclap Haftring
description: Land the paired heads on the rim of an armored guard and send qi down through it.

name: Vacuum Pulp
description: Burst a plate between the two heads so the shock passes into the body.

name: Bedrock Maceball
description: Press the whole field's weight down on a guard and hold it there with both heads.

name: Tempestuous Pound
description: Bring the paired heads down in a wide arc that strikes everyone in reach.

name: Thunderclap Bellhead
description: Cast the whole field's weight through both heads onto one point and press the target down beneath it.

name: Grand Volition Batter
description: The school's answer, a descent of both heads followed by a second that finishes where the first broke through.

name: Quenched Ironknob
description: Draw qi from the Core into the head so the overstroke lands with a steady, heavy weight.

name: Prismmace
description: Let a current of Core qi run through the haft and hold against a heavy blow.

name: Bedrock Smash
description: Step with the Core's weight settled low, keeping the head steady through the advance.

name: Thunderclap Studhead
description: Send a pulse of Core qi down the haft that unsteadies the grip of any weapon it touches.

name: Millstone Crush
description: Hook the flange over a limb and draw the opponent in with qi from the Core.

name: Maceneck Crown
description: Send a river of Core qi into the head and crush through plate and the limb beneath.

name: Peartriumph
description: Press a guard with the Core's whole weight in the head until the arm folds.

name: Entropy Dent
description: Sweep the head round with the Core's weight so every opponent near feels the blow.

name: Pulsarrib
description: Cast the Core's full weight through the haft in one fall that crushes the guard and the ground beneath it.

name: Destiny Bellhead
description: The school's answer, a river of Core qi released in successive strokes, each deeper into the opponent's guard.

name: Batter Banner
description: Open with a swing sworn to its mark, carrying it through the guard without pause.

name: Inviolate Flangerib
description: Turn blows aside with the haft held as a vane in the wind.

name: Ethereal Wristloop
description: Step forward along the bearing, head level and feet even, ready to strike or guard.

name: Squall Studhead
description: Rap the opponent's guard in beats like a rising gale until the grip loosens.

name: Denttroth
description: Hook the flange along the bearing line and pull the opponent's arm out of its guard.

name: Peal Maceneck
description: Check the opponent's swing at the edge of the reach with a quick, hard rap.

name: Radiance Pearhead
description: Drive an oath-sworn blow through plate and into the body behind it.

name: Volition Smash
description: Press a guard along the plateau of the forearm until the arm sinks.

name: Pulp Decree
description: Cast a sworn blow with a gale of qi behind it and break the guard in front.

name: Harmonious Volition Pound
description: The school's cycle of sworn strokes, each swung from a new bearing, ending in one stroke that holds the line.

name: Flangerib Crown
description: Strike down from a fixed bearing and give no ground to any counter.

name: Stately Haftring
description: Hold the haft across the front and refuse to move off the bearing.

name: Evanescent Batter
description: Pace along the bearing with the head low and the weight steady.

name: Crush Triumph
description: Strike with the knob along the plateau's edge where the opponent's guard is thin.

name: Millstone Wristloop
description: Bind the opponent's weapon with the haft and hold the bearing until their arm tires.

name: Pall Ironknob
description: Turn a blow aside on the flat of the haft without leaving the bearing.

name: Authoritative Ironknob
description: Press the opponent's weapon down along the bearing with the whole body's weight.

name: Vaunted Maceball
description: Break through a guard with a gale-weighted fall of the head along the bearing.

name: Quenched Maceball
description: Cast the plateau oath's whole weight into one stroke that breaks the guard and holds the arm down.

name: Battertriumph
description: The school's answer, a held bearing that strikes back at every blow, ending in a stroke at the weakest moment.

name: Poundbanner
description: Swing the heavy head overhead along the bearing, adding the body's full weight.

name: Steelmace
description: Hold the haft along the bearing and take a heavy blow without shifting a foot.

name: Smashodyssey
description: Step with the weight settled and the head held low, never leaving the bearing's line.

name: Famed Dent
description: Strike the rim of a guard along the bearing so the whole defence shifts.

name: Deluge Bellhead
description: Turn a heavy blow along the haft with qi through full meridians, never leaving the line.

name: Ribhead Troth
description: Hook the flange behind a limb along the bearing and haul it into the head's path.

name: Quenched Crush
description: Drive the head's weight and a gale of qi into one strike at the guard.

name: Dentverdict
description: Let the plateau's steady weight through the head crush plate and the bone beneath.

name: Seasonpear
description: Press the guard along the bearing until the opponent's arm gives and the stance breaks.

name: Magnificent Ribhead
description: Roll the head wide along the bearing and strike every opponent that stands in its path.

name: Batter Decree
description: Cast the whole gale into a single fall that crushes plate and drives the shock into the body behind.

name: Vigor Pound
description: The school's bearing stroke, a steady advance and fall that presses the opponent back on the line.

name: Thunderclap Dent
description: Strike from open ground with the full arc free and no cover behind.

name: Unwavering Pearhead
description: Hold the haft in the open and let the wind's weight spread along it.

name: Ribsolace
description: Step on any bearing the wind offers and plant for the next stroke.

name: Studhead Triumph
description: Rake the flange along an opponent's guard in the open, tearing at the cloth and padding.

name: Millstone Haftring
description: Hook the flange behind a limb at the edge of the reach and draw it out.

name: Ribpledge
description: Turn a heavy blow round the haft like a gale round a post.

name: Squall Maceneck
description: Land the full weight of the head and the body's turn on a single point in the open.

name: Steelpulp
description: Crush through a guard as if there were nothing behind it but open air.

name: Poundedict
description: Cast the whole wind's weight into a single swing that breaks the guard and shakes the ground around.

name: Orchestral Pulp Banner
description: The school's teaching stroke, a run of free swings that ends in one swing no cover can stop.

name: Ribverdict
description: Strike with a sworn field of qi round the head so the blow lands before the weapon.

name: Staunch Studhead
description: Spread the sworn field along the haft and take a blow into it without moving.

name: Nimble Ironknob
description: Step along a descending bearing, each pace bringing the head nearer its mark.

name: Revelation Bellhead
description: Spread the field out to the opponent's guard edge and feel its weight and give.

name: Macepledge
description: Bind the opponent's weapon to the haft with the field and hold the bearing against any pull.

name: Vigor Maceneck
description: Smash the rim of a guard with the field's weight so the arm behind it numbs.

name: Quenched Dent
description: Burst plate with a descent of the field's weight, the shock reaching the body.

name: Gloom Ribhead
description: Press a guard under the sworn weight until the opponent's arm gives way.

name: Famed Flangerib
description: Bring the field down in a wide arc that strikes every opponent in close reach.

name: Dauntless Crush
description: Cast the whole gale through the haft in one descent that crushes the guard and pins the arm.

name: Flangerib Edict
description: The school's answer, a sworn descent followed by a second that lands where the first has broken through.

name: Vigor Batter
description: Draw wind-like qi from the Core into the head so the overstroke lands with a steady weight.

name: Prism Pearhead
description: Let a held current of Core qi run through the haft against a heavy blow.

name: Silken Haftring
description: Step along the bearing with the Core's weight settled low and the head level.

name: Ruling Wristloop
description: Send a pulse of Core qi down the haft that unsteadies the grip of any weapon it touches.

name: Crushtroth
description: Hook the flange over a limb and draw the opponent along the bearing with Core qi.

name: Matchless Pulp
description: Send a gale of Core qi into the head and crush through plate and the limb beneath.

name: Seasoncrush
description: Press a guard with the Core's whole weight held in the head until the arm folds.

name: Demolition Bellhead
description: Sweep the head round with the Core's weight so every opponent in the arc feels the blow.

name: Maceball Crown
description: Cast the Core's full gale through the haft in one fall that crushes the guard and the ground beneath it.

name: Haftring Banner
description: The school's answer, a gale of Core qi released in successive strokes, each deeper into the opponent's guard.
